issue.body:
I've started experimenting with moving services from Flask over to ASGI specifically using starlette. I've got a few services up and running in production but I'm looking for what the consensus is on running sync code/packages inside a starlette app. Things like replacing the requests package with httpx are simple and make sense. Other things not so much.

I've looked a lot of places but not really found a definitive best practice. It boils down to this...

Assuming in real world apps for at least the time being it's useful to use stable well tested sync packages for some things is the best way to do this:

A) make all routes async and then use Starlette.concurrency and await run_in_threadpool(compute, *args, **kwargs) to run a set of sync code or...

B) make the route sync but then what is the best way to use Starlette request/response routines?

C) Something completely different?

Thanks.
